confirm.title: Link to Music Assistant
confirm.description: Listening Genome will build your listening profile from the Music Assistant integration **{ma_name}**. It stores only a reference to that entry, never its address or token.

pick.title: Choose a Music Assistant server
pick.description: More than one Music Assistant integration is set up. Choose the one whose listening history Listening Genome should use. Only a reference to it is stored, never its address or token.

error.ma_entry_missing: That Music Assistant entry no longer exists. Choose another.

abort.ma_not_configured: Listening Genome reads your history from Music Assistant, so the Music Assistant integration must be set up first. Add it under Settings > Devices & services, then add Listening Genome again.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Listening Genome is already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.

init.title: Listening Genome settings
init.description: How the genome is computed and when it is refreshed. Saving reloads the integration; if a setting that changes the result was edited, the genome is rebuilt straight away.

data.enrich_enabled: Look up artists on MusicBrainz and ListenBrainz

data_description.recency_half_life_days: A listen this many days old counts half as much as one today. 0 turns recency weighting off. 0 to 3650.
data_description.obscurity_percentile: An artist counts as obscure when fewer ListenBrainz listeners have played them than this share of all artists.
data_description.min_seconds_played: Plays shorter than this are stored but not counted. 0 to 600.
data_description.rebuild_schedule_hour: The genome is recomputed once a day at this hour, in Home Assistant's time zone. 0 to 23.
data_description.enrich_enabled: Every hour, identify new artists on MusicBrainz (genres, era, country) and fetch their ListenBrainz popularity. Needs internet access.

rebuild_failed.message: The listening genome could not be rebuilt: {error}
